note.en: These claims, their regions and their tests were written and committed before tools/catalog_build.py produced any series for the new variables. Each is a paraphrase of a claim people commonly make, not a quotation. knownBefore marks the one claim whose answer the baseline app already showed. Team: replace these with real Khmer and English headlines, with links, and commit them before looking at the board.

quote.km: កម្ពុជាកាន់តែក្តៅឡើង។

quote.en: Nights in Cambodia are getting warmer.
quote.km: ពេលយប់នៅកម្ពុជាកាន់តែក្តៅឡើង។

quote.en: Cambodia's dry season is getting drier.
quote.km: រដូវប្រាំងនៅកម្ពុជាកាន់តែស្ងួត។

quote.en: The air over Phnom Penh is getting hazier.
quote.km: ខ្យល់លើរាជធានីភ្នំពេញកាន់តែស្រអាប់។

quote.en: The Mekong Delta is drying out.
quote.km: តំបន់ដីសណ្តទន្លេមេគង្គកំពុងរីងស្ងួត។
វាលខ្សាច់សាហារ៉ាកាន់តែក្តៅឡើង។
ព្រៃអាម៉ាហ្សូនកំពុងរីងស្ងួត។

quote.en: The Arctic is losing its sea ice.
quote.km: តំបន់អាកទិកកំពុងបាត់បង់ទឹកកកសមុទ្រ។
